reaudit_note: Mechanical re-stamp by `./le rfc reseal`. Every verdict re-stamped below was in the SHIFTED state: its recorded unit fingerprints -- the enclosing top-level function of each tagged test -- were byte-identical to the tree, and only the file around them had moved (a line shift, a sibling test, an import rewrite). Nothing about what any of these tests asserts changed, so no verdict was re-judged and only the `tests` map was rewritten. A verdict whose unit, cited producer code, or requirement text moved was REFUSED and left stale for a human. The proof is the code in verdict_freshness(), not this note.

RFC4360-2-1.note: Judge 2026-09-30. Rib TestRFC4360ExtendedCommunitiesEqualOnlyOnAllEightOctets drives extCommunitiesEqual (rib_replay.go), the comparator that decides whether a replayed route's communities changed: + an octet-equal copy is equal; - flipping any one of the 8 octets makes it unequal. ExtendedCommunity is [8]byte, so equality elsewhere is whole-value by type; filter plugins match by policy, not equality, and are not driven.

RFC4360-x-1.note: Judge 2026-09-30. TestRFC4360ExtendedCommunitiesAreWholeEightOctetQuantities over ParseExtendedCommunities, the registered parser: + 8 and 16 octets yield one and two communities holding the exact octets in order; - 12 and 20 octets are refused with ErrInvalidLength, not truncated.
